text.tspan: Fertility rate among adolescent girls aged 15 to 19

The
age-specific fertility rate
for adolescent girls aged 15 to 19, measured as the number of live births per 1,000

girls in this age group. Future projections are based on the
UN's medium scenario
.
Data source: UN, World Population Prospects (2024)
